rule: No local delta may be added to 0.6660. ab85 gclpall 0.7040365552180464 fit the holdout (include_heldout_valid true).

hypotheses.statement: A public move of +0.034 from 0.6660 to 0.7000 is algebraically allowed and empirically unsupported as leftover in-sample estimation error. The same-sized local/public level gap is larger for D256 (0.700792587 local, 0.6641 public) than the seed-4 recipe's improvement, and E-301 already reports that class-mix reweighting does not remove the slope gap.
hypotheses.representation_change: Replace 'sum of pilot deltas' with a ceiling check: metric range, recorded post-alignment public steps, and mix sensitivity of the frozen champion.
hypotheses.causal_mechanism: After the type-A scorer repair (+0.0568), remaining recorded gains are O(0.001). The 0.034 local level gap is a different functional (1,505/1,873 validation sequences were fit; D256 wins the full file and loses publicly).
assumptions: No unidentified type-A scorer mismatch remains in the opened records
E-301's 'no mix fixes the slope' is about the level gap, not a champion-specific recomputation
hypotheses.predicted_observable: Reweighted WP of frozen seed-4 predictions across the published class-3 share interval ~0.41-0.51 stays a few thousandths, and later complete-predictor paired deltas stay O(0.001-0.003).
hypotheses.predicted_direction_or_delta: Not +0.034. Unknown exact mix range on seed-4 until the probe is run. Do not add any local delta to 0.6660.
hypotheses.cheap_test: CPU reweight of cached seed-4 predictions under the existing class-mix interval. No fit.
hypotheses.falsifier: A pre-registered public score >= 0.676 with no future labels. A local +0.01 does not falsify.
known_failure_modes: treating class WP or difference-mode energy as additive WP
using ab85 0.704 which fit the holdout

hypotheses.statement: The champion's missed covariance is concentrated in a deployable clock-cell x age-bucket x target cell. Eligible cells must be defined from inputs, not from target-derived class.
hypotheses.representation_change: Attribute w*(y-mean_y)*(p-mean_p) with global means so cells sum to the official numerator, crossed with (delta i0_p0, delta i0_p11) in {00,10,01,11} and age buckets from both the OR clock and the AND clock.
hypotheses.causal_mechanism: Pooled correlation is dominated by high-|y| rows. The strong 16-group diagnostic shows age-0 WP 0.8496 vs 128+ WP 0.4728, while class 2 does not decay and class 3 does; excluded-368 t0 0.687627604 is weaker than t1 0.712016713. A specialist on a low-weight cell cannot move the pool by 0.034.
assumptions: Cached seed-4 complete predictions match the submitted equal parent/head
Component resampling is descriptive, not a fresh holdout
hypotheses.predicted_observable: Weight share and covariance contribution per cell, per target, on the 368 excluded sequences, with a fit-only table stored separately and not used to pick the winner.
hypotheses.predicted_direction_or_delta: Unknown until computed. Promotion requires weight share >= 0.15 and a component interval on the per-weight deficit that excludes zero versus the complement.
hypotheses.cheap_test: CPU pass over cached predictions and raw i0_p0/i0_p11. No training.
hypotheses.falsifier: No deployable cell meets the 15% weight gate, or age-0 event cells hold the deficit the narrative assigned to long quiet rows.
known_failure_modes: using target class as a deployable gate
adding cell WP to get the official score
hypotheses.not_a_duplicate_of: Not an event/quiet residual network. It is a partition of the existing numerator.

hypotheses.statement: The OR event law (3,761/3,763) and the production AND flag ev_i0px are not yet shown to be the same bit, and a6 has not been identified with either.
hypotheses.representation_change: A scored-row contingency of label-change by clock cell, plus agreement of a6 changes with OR and AND.
hypotheses.causal_mechanism: Every later event model conditions on a bit. If label changes are almost all cell 11, OR vs AND is empty. If many are single-sided, ev_i0px misses them even though the raw columns are already inputs.
assumptions: a6 is the column named in research/campaign_2026-10-03/eda/puzzle_a/scan2.py
scored destination mask matches gmetric selection
hypotheses.predicted_observable: Counts of (dp0, dp11, label_changed) on need_prediction AND is_scored, and the symmetric-difference rate of a6 versus AND and OR.
hypotheses.predicted_direction_or_delta: Unknown. Do not invent the rate.
hypotheses.cheap_test: Same CPU pass as CC-20261006-FACTOR. No fit.
hypotheses.falsifier: AND agrees with OR on label changes up to the known handful of exceptions, and a6 matches that bit. Then drop clock-identity work.
known_failure_modes: quoting 3761/3763 as if it were the AND clock
hypotheses.not_a_duplicate_of: Not 'add event features'. The incumbent already has ev_i0px, since_*, and last deltas.

hypotheses.statement: A five-mark linear Hawkes compensator of observable book events carries excitation that is not collinear with age and ev_i0px, and a matched shuffled-mark control does not.
hypotheses.representation_change: Inputs Lambda_k(t)=exp(-beta)*Lambda_k(t-1)+1{mark k}, marks {p0-only, p11-only, both prices, i0 trade, i0 volume}, beta fixed from the training inter-event age histogram.
hypotheses.causal_mechanism: Mutually exciting point processes summarize history by the compensator. A row-wise GRU must store that excitation in hidden state. This is not a binary quiet/event gate, not LRU, and not a gated delta write v-Sk.
assumptions: Linear constant-beta excitation is a sufficient probe
Marks are functions of current and previous raw columns only
P1 weight gate passed; otherwise this fit is not admitted
hypotheses.predicted_observable: Partial weighted correlation of FWL residuals of Lambda (against age_OR, age_AND, ev_i0px, since_i0px) with frozen seed-4 (y-p), per target, versus a within-sequence mark shuffle.
hypotheses.predicted_direction_or_delta: Unknown. No local delta is a forecast of public score.
hypotheses.cheap_test: Probe correlations first. Only if they clear the placebo, one complete seed of the incumbent recipe with Lambda inputs versus shuffled Lambda, same final head.
hypotheses.falsifier: Every partial-correlation component interval covers 0, or the shuffled placebo matches the real compensator, or the complete one-seed paired delta is <= 0 after the final head.
known_failure_modes: beta grid search on the evaluation panel
replacing the GRU with a neural Hawkes

estimated_cost.gpu_hours: one production-shaped seed if the probe survives; else 0

hypotheses.not_a_duplicate_of: October 5 elephants review names gated delta and LRU. Positive-kernel attention was the E467/E469 arm and went mixed/negative. This falsifier is a shuffled-mark partial correlation, not another attention width.

hypotheses.statement: Train-decoded signed touch depletion/refill intensities, residualized against existing event features, still have a partial correlation with the champion residual. E-215 did not test this.
hypotheses.representation_change: Replace raw 22-column volume-code shocks with a low-dimensional decoded intensity on the i0 event clock.
hypotheses.causal_mechanism: Queue depletion changes the hazard of the next price mark. Raw code displacement confounds dictionary noise with that intensity, which is why E-215's AUC fell by 0.040 and 0.009.
assumptions: A stable train-only code dictionary exists
The intensity is not a relabeling of E413's volume28 history
hypotheses.predicted_observable: FWL partial weighted correlation on excluded components, then at most one complete-seed input arm if CC-20261006-FACTOR assigns the deficit to a volume-linked cell and Hawkes is collinear.
hypotheses.predicted_direction_or_delta: Unknown. E-215's negative AUC is evidence against the raw shock, not an expected delta for intensities.
hypotheses.cheap_test: Event-level partial correlation on cached predictions before any GPU fit.
hypotheses.falsifier: Partial correlation interval covers 0 on both targets, or the feature is >0.95 correlated with an existing last_d_i0 / ev_i0 channel.

estimated_cost.class: probe, or one complete fit only as the P2 substitute

hypotheses.closing_evidence_that_did_not_test_this: E-215 claim: raw 22-column i0 volume-code displacement fails; 'does not rule out train-decoded queue refill/depletion intensities.'

hypotheses.statement: Correlation gradients through the recurrent trunk, with a denominator that survives constant class-3 chunks, are untested. E-023 killed per-chunk corr only.
hypotheses.representation_change: Parent loss wmse versus wmse_gcorr or gcorr_pool, same teachers and the same final head. gcorr_weight is already 1.0 in the seed-4 provenance and is ignored because loss is wmse.
hypotheses.causal_mechanism: The head's gcorr epoch already showed that finite-model WP and weighted MSE disagree (public head +0.0013; strong diagnostic: head WP up, weighted MSE worse, prediction sd up). Trunk features never received that gradient.
assumptions: weighted_pooled_corr_loss is not already applied on the wmse branch
A fixed or accumulated denominator is used so constant chunks do not zero the loss
hypotheses.predicted_observable: Complete-predictor paired WP and a feature-covariance check that the trunk moved, not only the head scale.
hypotheses.predicted_direction_or_delta: Unknown. E-023's 0.29 versus 0.60 is not the predicted delta.
hypotheses.cheap_test: Confirm in one forward that wmse ignores gcorr_weight (already true in train_rnn.py:1801-1812), then one paired complete seed, not an H64 panel.
hypotheses.falsifier: Trunk representations match the wmse parent within the head's ability to absorb the change, or constant-target chunks still produce a vanishing denominator, or the complete paired delta is <= 0.

estimated_cost.note: not in the next three unless P1 fails closed and a human replaces P2; default P2 is Hawkes/depletion

hypotheses.closing_evidence_that_did_not_test_this: E-023 corr 0.2937/0.2575 vs mix 0.6036/0.5983; H-018 note that per-chunk correlation is degenerate on constant class-3 chunks.

hypotheses.statement: An input-only lag-4 recurrence gate with a lag-7 sham on reserved components is unrun. The +0.007909 ridge was closed by concentration in two sequences.
hypotheses.representation_change: One predeclared lag versus sham, not a period scan.
hypotheses.causal_mechanism: puzzle_b recurrence4 added +0.006931 and full4 +0.007909 versus cap4, but excluding rg54 and rg1385 cut the full4 delta to +0.000613.
assumptions: New components are chosen without target-derived scale
t0 and t1 are both reported
hypotheses.predicted_observable: Component-paired WP of baseline-plus-lag4 minus baseline-plus-sham.
hypotheses.cheap_test: Frozen correction on cached strong states, sham-controlled, before any trunk fit.
hypotheses.falsifier: Gain confined to the same corner regimes, or t1 loss offsets t0, or sham matches lag4.
hypotheses.closing_evidence_that_did_not_test_this: puzzle_b REPORT: excluding both corners reduces +0.007909 to +0.000613. The report's own next test was not run.

hypotheses.statement: A cointegration-style residual of reconstructed levels is untested. Univariate i1 AUC closed only H-013.
hypotheses.representation_change: Causal deviation of a train-only reconstructed level from its own EMA, then FWL against existing price-difference features.
hypotheses.causal_mechanism: H-016 showed raw jump sums do not reproduce targets; anchor changes dominate. A slow level residual can still correlate with the champion error without being an online price decoder.
assumptions: No physical instrument identity is claimed
hypotheses.predicted_observable: Partial weighted correlation with frozen seed-4 residual on excluded rows, per target.
hypotheses.predicted_direction_or_delta: Unknown. E-017 AUC 0.525/0.528 is not a predicted delta.
hypotheses.cheap_test: CPU partial correlation. No fit unless the partial interval excludes zero and the feature is not collinear with existing inputs.
hypotheses.falsifier: Partial correlation covers 0, or the residual is a linear function of features already in the incumbent.
hypotheses.closing_evidence_that_did_not_test_this: E-017 class-3 AUC 0.525 and 0.528. H-013 note: a proper cointegration residual on reconstructed levels is not yet tested.
